02c767c9c23fc21e.name: sandbox_glob
02c767c9c23fc21e.description: Find files by name pattern in this conversation's sandbox. Use it to list files and to locate files by name, e.g. pattern "**/*.py" for all Python files. The pattern is matched against paths relative to path (default /workspace): * matches within one directory, ** matches across directories, ? matches one character, {a,b} matches either. Returns absolute paths sorted by name, up to 1000. To search file contents, use sandbox_grep.

path.description: Absolute directory to search in. Default /workspace.

pattern.description: Glob pattern relative to path, e.g. "**/*.csv" or "src/*.ts".

0ed12e8c3064dece.name: sandbox_grep
0ed12e8c3064dece.description: Search file contents in this conversation's sandbox with a regular expression (POSIX extended, as grep -E). Use it to find where something is defined or mentioned. Searches path (a file, or a directory recursively; default /workspace), skipping binary files; glob limits the files searched by name, e.g. "*.py". Returns matching lines as <path>:<line>:<text>, up to 500. To find files by name, use sandbox_glob.

glob.description: Only search files whose name matches this glob, e.g. "*.md".

path.description: Absolute file or directory to search. Default /workspace.

pattern.description: Regular expression (POSIX extended), e.g. "def [a-z_]+\(" or "TODO".

2a8960eea6a19ac2.name: sandbox_bash
2a8960eea6a19ac2.description: Run a shell command (bash) in this conversation's sandbox, an isolated Linux machine. Use it to run programs and scripts, install packages, process files and inspect the filesystem. The working directory is /workspace; files persist between calls in the same conversation, but background processes may not: when the sandbox is suspended after a period without use they can be stopped and /tmp cleared, so keep results in files under /workspace. Files the user attached to the conversation are under /workspace/attachments, and skill files under /skills (read-only). Each call runs in a fresh shell (no state such as cd or environment variables carries over). The result has stdout, stderr and the exit code; long output is saved and can be paged with read_tool_output. A command that runs longer than timeoutSeconds is stopped. Prefer sandbox_read, sandbox_write, sandbox_edit, sandbox_glob and sandbox_grep for reading, writing and searching files. To give a file to the user, use sandbox_deliver. Other sub-agents of this conversation may run commands in this sandbox at the same time. Always pass description: a few words saying what the command is for; the user sees it instead of the command.

command.description: The command line to run, e.g. "python3 analyze.py data.csv".

description.description: What this command does, in a few words (e.g. "Generate the final PDF"). Shown to the user.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before the command is stopped. Default 120; the deployment sets a maximum (7200 by default).

3f16f65e9447ef63.name: sandbox_edit
3f16f65e9447ef63.description: Edit a text file in this conversation's sandbox by replacing exact text. oldText must match the file exactly (including whitespace and indentation) and, unless replaceAll is true, occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. Read the file with sandbox_read first. Use sandbox_write to create a file or replace all of it.

path.description: Absolute path of the file, e.g. "/workspace/src/app.py".

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence of oldText instead of exactly one. Default false.

4753d83e282a440b.name: skill_load
4753d83e282a440b.description: Load a skill from the skills list: returns the skill's instructions (its SKILL.md) and the list of its files. Call it before starting a task that matches a skill's description, then follow the returned instructions. If the skill has scripts or other files, they are copied read-only to /skills/<name>/ in this conversation's sandbox; run scripts there with an interpreter (sh, python3, node). Call it again when the skills list changes or the sandbox was recreated. Do not use it for skills that are not in the list.

8fc2fef3878cde56.name: sandbox_read

c8a1492e56413e61.name: read_tool_output

If a single line is too long, it is cut and the result says which offset and charOffset to call again with. Outputs expire after a retention period.
